card.name: Digits and small words in dosing tables
card.fires_on: Single digits inside multi-digit numbers (dose, day or cycle numbers) and short linking words such as 'on', 'due', 'in' in label headings and phrases. It mostly fires where the next piece continues a number or a repeated phrase.

modes.label: Inside numbers
modes.description: A digit within a multi-digit dose or schedule number, before the rest of the number.

modes.label: Short linking words
modes.description: A small word like 'on', 'due' or 'in' in a heading or repeated phrase.
